mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of potassium and can reduce creatinine clearance, while candesartan increases serum potassium through angiotensin II receptor blockade, creating additive hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function regularly; consider alternative antibiotics if trimethoprim must be used with candesartan, especially in patients with renal impairment or baseline hyperkalemia.
